question: Estimate the unique reach of a hoarding (OOH) campaign on Mumbai's Western Express Highway.
idealClarificationQuestions: Single hoarding for a 30-day campaign on WEH (one of Mumbai's busiest roads)? Yes.
Reach = unique people who saw the hoarding at least once? Yes.
WEH stretch: ~40 km Andheri-Borivali-Dahisar area? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Daily traffic × campaign duration × unique-passenger conversion.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: WEH daily vehicular traffic (BMC + traffic police data): ~2.5 lakh vehicles/day passing a given prime hoarding location.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, repeat commuters (same person passing daily): ~70% = ~3.85 lakh repeat individuals.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Add pedestrians and side-road viewers: ~5 lakh extra.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~55-60 lakh unique people in 30 days.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: WEH daily vehicular traffic (BMC + traffic police data)
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~2.5 lakh vehicles/day passing a given prime hoarding location.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Average occupancy per vehicle (cars + 2W + buses + autos)
Of these, repeat commuters (same person passing daily)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~1.65 lakh new + 3.85 lakh repeats; daily total impressions ~5.5 lakh.

calculationFlow: WEH daily vehicular traffic (BMC + traffic police data): ~2.5 lakh vehicles/day passing a given prime hoarding location.
Average occupancy per vehicle (cars + 2W + buses + autos): ~2.2 people = ~5.5 lakh person-pass-bys per day.
Of these, repeat commuters (same person passing daily): ~70% = ~3.85 lakh repeat individuals.
Unique person-pass-bys per day: ~1.65 lakh new + 3.85 lakh repeats; daily total impressions ~5.5 lakh.
Over 30 days, accumulating new unique commuters (visitors, occasional travellers): ~3.85 lakh repeats + 30 × 1.65 lakh = ~3.85L + 49.5L = ~53 lakh unique people.
Add pedestrians and side-road viewers: ~5 lakh extra.
Round: ~55-60 lakh unique people in 30 days.
